limitations: Evidence class: numerical verification on ref-x86-64 (TRS2): analytic mpmath expectations (G7-G10) and independent hand models over certified production re-solves (G19, G20). Not empirical validation, and not optimality evidence: KKT_POINT_VERIFIED is numerically verified local stationarity of the held-regime problem; second-order conditions are not assessed.

Status tested, not reviewed: ADR 0071 and ADR 0019 Amendment 16 are Accepted (2026-11-08, Frank, decision board). The human description reviews (validate, submit_job) are recorded by Frank on the branch (9869773e), not by an agent. The design-lane prose check of D-92's catalogue entries and of D-93 (MSG corpus C12) is pending, as is the reviewer pass. No local full gate was run; the merge condition is CI run 42534167073 (CLAUDE.md gate by risk, 2026-11-08).

Optimising needs the audited nlp environment on linux-x86_64 and the revision_eo route; elsewhere validate/submit_job are unsupported (nlp_solver_unavailable), and coupled or legacy_eo documents are UNSUPPORTED (OPTIMIZATION_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE). Phase and assessment regimes are held per start; two-phase-side and unguarded-regime boundary optima and the rank-limited-but-inactive gap are NOT_VERIFIED; the zero subsystem is all or nothing per start (design section 9.7). Declared in the guide (D-82): (a) gamma-phi held splits certify and are unguarded (regimes_unguarded); (b) pr-c1-v1 held single-phase splits give REGIME_MARGIN_UNDEFINED; (c) thermal-port boundary candidates fail V1; (d) the N1 absolute flow thresholds (a row is active when |a/N0| is at most 1e-6, a two-phase margin min(V, L)/N0 is at least 1e-4, N0 = 3 mol/s), fail-safe; (e) S1 dormant splits: a revision with a ZERO_FLOW split is NOT_VERIFIED at every candidate (fail-safe, a fix is queued, D-84).

Robustness (D-70): with Ipopt's fixed options (monotone barrier, limited-memory Hessian) OPT-L stalls at max_iter from the feasible side (starts {673.15 K, 650 K}; start 0 SOLVER_FAILED; 661 K and other scales too) and verifies from 650 K. Such starts are reported SOLVER_FAILED, never verified.
G12 masks the wall-clock members of the record (D-63); D-58 (Q26 allow-list) and D-60 (resolver) await the design-lane review.
